verified: The Wall Street Journal reports that a worldwide memory chip shortage has led companies to form dedicated procurement teams and that some chip prices have climbed as much as 10x in a year, driving electronics prices up.
unconfirmed: Which specific memory products and companies are seeing the tenfold increases, how broadly that figure applies across the market, and any independent price data — the available account is a short summary of the WSJ article, so volume, contract terms and timing details are missing.

verified: 《华尔街日报》报道称全球存在存储芯片短缺，多家公司为此设立采购“作战室”，部分芯片价格一年内涨幅最高达10倍，并推动电子产品涨价。
unconfirmed: 具体是哪些芯片品类与型号涨了10倍、涨幅的统计来源与时间段、短缺波及的厂商范围与持续时间；Techmeme的摘要仅截取了报道开头，未提供价格数据、受访企业名单或行业机构的独立核实。

titles.en: Memory chip shortage drives 10x price rises and corporate procurement war rooms, WSJ reports
titles.zh: 存储芯片短缺，部分芯片一年涨10倍，企业设采购作战室，《华尔街日报》报道
